summary: Swedish Export Credit Corp filed a Form 6-K with its interim report for Q1 2026, showing net interest income of Skr 684 million, operating profit of Skr 504 million, and a return on equity of 6.7%. The report discusses market volatility and new credit commitments of Skr 15.3 billion, with no mention of any merger, acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation. This is a routine periodic financial report by a foreign private issuer, with no structural corporate event disclosed, so it does not qualify as a special situation under the defined categories.
